programme.desc: Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.desc: McBride agrees to give his accountant a hand in a bitter custody battle but when the man is accused of murdering his therapist, everything changes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 1: Mystery Weekend
programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 2: Snapshot
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: The Pleasure of Your Company
programme.desc: Romantic comedy, starring Jason Biggs and Isla Fisher. Loved-up Anderson is in the middle of proposing to his girlfriend when the unthinkable happens and she dies. He sinks into depression and is convinced he will never find love again. However, a year later, he impulsively pops the question to a waitress and she agrees. Joe Pantoliano also features.

programme.title: Bring It On
programme.desc: A champion high school cheerleading squad discovers its previous captain stole all their best routines from an inner-city school and must scramble to compete at this year's championships.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol Compilations

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: The Flood
programme.desc: Incredible nature documentary series, narrated by amazing actress Angela Bassett, presents a two-part journey through the life cycle of one of the planet's last real wildernesses and tells the captivating tale of varios animals that live in the heart of Africa's Okavango Delta. Surrounded by the Kalahari Desert, the delta is a place of spectacular natural dramas where the lives of tens of thousands of animals each year depend on The Great Flood. Okawango welcomes leopards, elephants, lions, hippos,... each year as the great flood returns water to the habitat, and when the waters recede, the battle for survival begins.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol Compilations
programme.desc: There's not much that Dr. Jan Pol hasn't seen throughout his long, veterinarian career. The Dutch-born veterinarian has been helping animals since he graduated from Utrecht University in 1970. In this series we look back at memorable moments from his reality series, The Incredible Dr. Pol, where alongside his employees and his family he helps nurse a variety of creatures back to health from his Michigan-based practice. His clients come in all shapes and sizes, often needing urgent medical assistance, something that Dr. Jan Pol lives for. The passionate veterinarian is always keen to help, and we revisit the original series' greatest moments.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads to the mysterious blue depths to discover which animal dominates the sea. His first encounter is with a tiger shark, the notorious hunter shaped like a torpedo and armed with ferocious teeth! Next, Phil dives with a group of magnificent manta rays and listens to the songs of one of the largest creatures on Earth, the majestic humpback whale.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the mangroves to discover which animal is truly built to survive the mud and muck. Finally, Phil faces a creature we all love to hate—the mosquito—and discovers there's more to these tiny bloodsuckers than meets the eye.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin leaves the Australian mainland to discover which of the island-dwelling animals is truly built to survive. First up, he meets the enigmatic green turtle on the Wellesley Islands. Next, he is on K'Gari (Fraser Island), where he tracks down a pack of the notorious dingoes. Finally, he encounters the formidable and aptly named death adder snake.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin dares into the Australian savannah to find the species most built to survive. First is Australia's largest bird of prey, the majestic but intimidating wedge-tailed eagle. Next, Phil tracks down one of the world's deadliest snakes, the coastal taipan. Finally, Phil faces the uniquely Australian frill-necked lizard, a reptile with fascinating defense mechanisms.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.desc: Reality series following husband and wife veterinarians Ben and Erin Schroeder as they tend to animals in rural Nebraska. In this picturesque corner of the midwestern state, doctors Ben and Erin do all they can to ensure the local animals get the attention and care they deserve. Braving fierce blizzards, treacherous tornados and scorching summers, the pair of veterinarians let nothing stop them from administering medical treatment to local livestock.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: Before the Prism Battle, Shadow and Sonic go head-to-head in an epic fight. In present-day New Yoke City, the Chaos Council discover Sonic's mysterious connection to their own coveted power source and plan to extract it by any means necessary.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: The rebels battle the Chaos Council to secure the "Crystal" that gives the Council supreme power. Sonic assumes this crystal is the Paradox Prism, but he's stunned by the truth about the Power Crystal... and the events that shattered the world.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Watching too many ninja movies has brainwashed Leonard the koala. During the day, as he sleeps, he terrorizes everyone by sleepfighting (as opposed to sleepwalking). Private and the ducklings become trapped in the lair with the food, and as the rats and wasps try to break in, Private must think fast - how can he combat both gangs at once?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins notice it's been quiet at night. Too quiet, something's amiss. The rest of the zoo animals have been sneaking out at night to spend time partying in the park! The plan to sneak out then return by morning to avoid getting caught by Alice is put in jeopardy when they run into the classic New York problem - a traffic jam in the tunnel. How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. Having grown up with no natural enemies, Dode has no fear and it leads him to daredevilish behavior - the kind that can make you extinct over and over again. The penguins don't want to see this keep happening to their friend, they need to find a way to slow this crazy bird down!

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di rosso

Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il torbido passato. L’armonia di coppia sembra di acciaio ma c’è qualcuno che è infastidito dalla loro felicità e nuovi squilibri si affacciano all’orizzonte mettendo a rischio il loro legame. Kim Basinger interpreta Elena, la socia in affari ed ex amante di Christian, oltre ad essere colei che lo ha introdotto nello sfaccettato universo delle perversioni sessuali.

Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.desc: Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Bruni Tedeschi nel biopic che racconta vita e arte di Luigi Pirandello. Il ritratto intimo del grande drammaturgo e la cronaca della sua esistenza, scandita dal rapporto burrascoso con la moglie e dall'amore per una giovane musa.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: Il grande Steven Spielberg dirige i premi Oscar Anthony Hopkins e Morgan Freeman in un appassionante dramma storico-giudiziario. 1839: un gruppo di schiavi, imbarcati sulla nave Amistad per essere venduti, si ribellano e uccidono parte dell'equipaggio tentando il dirottamento verso l'Africa. Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: Una fantastica June Squibb è la trascinatrice di una action-comedy carica di humor. Los Angeles: vittima di una truffa telefonica, l'ostinata e orgogliosa novantatreenne Thelma si arma di coraggio e si avventura alla ricerca del delinquente che le ha estorto il denaro.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: La pazza gioia
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi e Micaela Ramazzotti nel road movie al femminile di Paolo Virzì. Due donne fuggono da una clinica psichiatrica e si avventurano a riassaporare il mondo.

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: L'orto americano
programme.desc: Dal suo romanzo, Pupi Avanti dirige Filippo Scotti in un film dalle atmosfere sospese. Nei giorni della Liberazione, un ragazzo si innamora di un'infermiera dell'esercito americano.

programme.title: American Gigolo
programme.desc: Il film cult degli anni '80 che ha consacrato il mito sexy di Richard Gere. Un affascinante gigolo' finisce nei guai quando una delle sue clienti viene ritrovata barbaramente uccisa.

programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

programme.desc: Lo spettacolare esordio alla regia di Sergio Leone. Sull'isola greca un gruppo di congiurati si ribella contro il Re Serse, mentre i Fenici stanno per attaccare la citta'.

programme.title: Attrazione fatale
programme.desc: Passione pericolosa fra Glenn Close e Michael Douglas in un cult degli anni '80, firmato dal regista di "9 settimane e 1/2". Dan Gallagher, un avvocato di New York felicemente sposato, tradisce la moglie con una sconosciuta, che non si accontenta di una sola notte e comincia a perseguitarlo rendendogli la vita un inferno. Le provocazioni della psicopatica si fanno sempre piu' asfissianti, fino a quando la donna comunica a Dan di essere incinta, rifiutandosi di abortire. La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.desc: I registi insieme ai protagonisti del BarLume danno voce a un divertente racconto del dietro le quinte delle nuove storie de "I delitti del BarLume".

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Un gruppo di criminali rapisce la figlia dodicenne di un misterioso riccastro. La ragazzina si rivela essere una feroce vampira, pronta a difendersi con le unghie e soprattutto con i denti dai suoi malcapitati aguzzini.

programme.title: God is a Bullet
programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Maika Monroe e Jamie Foxx nel film Sky Original di Nick Cassavetes. Per salvare la figlia, il detective Bob Hightower si infiltra in una setta satanica.

programme.title: Manhattan Nocturne
programme.desc: Palpitante thriller con Adrien Brody. Un giornalista newyorkese sprofonda in un vortice di pericoli mortali quando un'attraente sconosciuta lo convince ad indagare sull'omicidio del marito.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano quattro pellicole premiate a Venezia 2024, in prima visione nella collezione 'Film da Leoni', dal 27 agosto al 6 settembre.

programme.title: Le Notti Di Salem
programme.desc: Tornato alla sua città natale nella speranza di riprendere a scrivere, Ben Mears scopre che è dominata dai vampiri e che l'unico modo per liberarla è entrare a far parte di una banda che sta tentando di sconfiggere queste creature.

programme.title: Fino alla fine
programme.desc: Gabriele Muccino torna alla regia con un thriller coinvolgente. In vacanza in Italia, Sophie incontra Giulio e decide di seguirlo, ma la nottata prenderà una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Thriller con Kevin Costner, Gary Oldman e Ryan Reynolds. La memoria di un defunto agente della CIA, in possesso di informazioni top secret, viene trasferita nella mente di un detenuto.

programme.desc: Anthony Mackie e Jamie Dornan in un fanta-thriller allucinato. New Orleans: una droga sintetica conduce chi ne fa uso dentro un incubo spaventoso. Un paramedico decide di sperimentare la sostanza su di sé, finendo per vagare in una realtà totalmente alterata.

programme.title: The Shift
programme.desc: Alessandro Tonda, nel suo esordio alla regia, dirige una pellicola ad alta tensione con Clotilde Hesme e Adamo Dionisi. Due studenti musulmani compiono un attentato in una scuola di Bruxelles. I paramedici ne caricano uno sull’ambulanza, ignari della sua cintura esplosiva.

programme.title: Omicidio nel West End
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell, Saoirse Ronan e Adrien Brody tra humor e mistero. Londra, anni 50: un ispettore e la sua assistente indagano sull'omicidio di un noto regista.

programme.title: The Wasp
programme.desc: Naomie Harris e Natalie Dormer, una delle star de "Il Trono di Spade", in un intricato thriller psicologico dalla suspense serrata. Stufa di subire le prepotenze del marito, Heather ricontatta dopo molti anni una ex compagna di scuola per proporle di uccidere l'uomo.

programme.title: Voglia di potere
programme.desc: Jason Robards e Forest Whitaker in un serrato thriller politico TV. Stati Uniti: un colonnello deve impedire un golpe organizzato da un insospettabile e pluridecorato generale.

programme.title: Le Notti Di Salem
programme.desc: Tornato alla sua città natale nella speranza di riprendere a scrivere, Ben Mears scopre che è dominata dai vampiri e che l'unico modo per liberarla è entrare a far parte di una banda che sta tentando di sconfiggere queste creature.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Spiral - L'eredità di Saw
programme.desc: Reboot della saga di "Saw " con Chris Rock e Samuel L. Jackson. Un detective segue le tracce di un serial killer che uccide i poliziotti dopo averli sottoposti ad atroci torture.

programme.title: Occhiali neri
programme.desc: Dario Argento torna alla regia di un horror con Ilenia Pastorelli e Asia Argento. In una Roma immersa nelle tenebre, una escort non vedente finisce nel mirino di un serial killer.

programme.title: Synchronic
programme.desc: Anthony Mackie e Jamie Dornan in un fanta-thriller allucinato. New Orleans: una droga sintetica conduce chi ne fa uso dentro un incubo spaventoso. Un paramedico decide di sperimentare la sostanza su di sé, finendo per vagare in una realtà totalmente alterata.

programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e Carey Mulligan nell'action di Nicolas Winding Refn, miglior regia a Cannes. Autista al soldo della malavita, uno stuntman si infatua della donna sbagliata e finisce nei guai.

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: Liam Hemsworth e Dwayne Johnson in un action senza respiro, tratto da una storia vera. Due giovani immigrati greci mettono a segno un colpo milionario, ma un detective è sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: Pig, il piano di Rob
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage in un film ambientato nelle impervie lande dell’Oregon. Un solitario cacciatore di tartufi vive nella sua fattoria in compagnia dell’amata e preziosa scrofa. Quando l’animale viene rapito, l’uomo si mette in viaggio verso i luoghi del suo passato per ritrovarlo.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Mary J. Blige in un thriller avvolto in un pauroso mistero. Un’agente di polizia di Los Angeles indaga sull’inspiegabile morte di un collega, avvenuta durante un controllo di routine. Il suo unico indizio è un filmato che lascia supporre l’esistenza di una creatura soprannaturale.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Detective Marlowe
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original di Neil Jordan con Liam Neeson, Diane Kruger e Jessica Lange. Hollywood, anni 30: il detective Marlowe e' incaricato di ritrovare l'ex amante di un'ereditiera.

programme.title: Io sono leggenda
programme.desc: Cult di fantascienza con Will Smith. Un virus ha decimato l'umanita' trasformando i superstiti in mostri. Uno scienziato immune al morbo studia una cura nel suo laboratorio.

programme.title: Cena con delitto - Knives Out
programme.desc: Daniel Craig e un super cast in una movimentata commedia-thriller. Un detective indaga sulla famiglia di un ricco scrittore per scoprirne l'assassino.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult e Willem Dafoe nel remake di un classico dell'horror gotico, diretto da Robert Eggers. Un agente immobiliare viene inviato nei Carpazi, nello spettrale castello di un ambiguo conte, ossessionato dalla sposa del suo ospite.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e Carey Mulligan nell'action di Nicolas Winding Refn, miglior regia a Cannes. Autista al soldo della malavita, uno stuntman si infatua della donna sbagliata e finisce nei guai.

programme.title: Armi chimiche
programme.desc: Ben Kingsley e Monica Bellucci in uno spy-thriller. Una donna avvenente e fatale complica i piani di un anziano agente del Mossad, alle prese con l'ultima missione della sua vita.

programme.title: In amore niente regole
programme.desc: George Clooney dirige e interpreta una commedia brillante con Renee Zellweger e John Krasinski. 1925: un capitano di football e un giovane fuoriclasse si innamorano della stessa donna.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
programme.desc: Steve Carell, Ryan Gosling, Emma Stone e Julianne Moore in una commedia romantica. Un giovane seduttore aiuta un marito tradito e lasciato dalla moglie a rimettersi in gioco.

programme.title: La Febbre
programme.desc: Mario Bettini, un giovane geometra trentenne, si trova a ripensare alla propria vita, particolarmente dopo l'incontro con una ballerina.

programme.title: Ex
programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige una commedia corale con Claudio Bisio, Nancy Brilli e Alessandro Gassmann. La ricomparsa degli ex mette in crisi il rapporto di sei coppie.

programme.title: Nessuno mi puo' giudicare
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia di Max Bruno con Paola Cortellesi, Raoul Bova, Rocco Papaleo e Anna Foglietta. Dopo la morte del marito, una donna decide di diventare una escort per pagare i debiti (ITA 2011).

programme.title: Little Italy - Pizza, amore e fantasia
programme.desc: Emma Roberts e Hayden Christensen in una commedia romantica nel cuore italiano di Toronto. Una giovane coppia di innamorati deve resistere all'accesa rivalita' tra i rispettivi genitori.

programme.title: After 2
programme.desc: Josephine Langford e Hero Fiennes Tiffin nel romantico sequel tratto dal romanzo di Anna Todd. Dopo la fine della loro love story, Tessa e Hardin hanno preso strade diverse ma i due ragazzi non riescono a dimenticarsi e sfidano ogni ostacolo pur di tornare insieme.

programme.title: Proposta indecente
programme.desc: Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson e Robert Redford nell'indimenticabile pellicola firmata dal regista di "Nove settimane e mezzo" e "Attrazione fatale". Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.title: Partnerperfetto.com
programme.desc: Diane Lane e John Cusack in una romantica commedia sui cuori solitari. Una quarantenne divorziata viene spinta dalle sorelle a incontrare uomini conosciuti sul web, con effetti esilaranti.

programme.title: In amore niente regole
programme.desc: George Clooney dirige e interpreta una commedia brillante con Renee Zellweger e John Krasinski. 1925: un capitano di football e un giovane fuoriclasse si innamorano della stessa donna.

Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.desc: Commedia corale con Luca e Paolo, Ambra Angiolini e Claudia Gerini. Quattro coppie ricevono la notizia che il loro matrimonio e' stato annullato e devono ripresentarsi davanti all'altare.

programme.desc: Piefrancesco Favino e Stefano Accorsi nel film corale di Gabriele Muccino. Gli equilibri di una famiglia si sfaldano durante un soggiorno forzato su un'isola del Mediterraneo.

programme.title: Il quiz dell'amore
programme.desc: Avventure e disavventure sentimentali per James McAvoy (il giovane Professor X della saga di "X-Men"). Inghilterra, Anni'80. Brian viene ammesso all'Universita' di Bristol nonostante venga da una famiglia di umili origini. Appassionato di quiz sin da bambino, entra nella cerchia ristretta degli studenti in procinto di partecipare in tv al famoso "University Challenge". Ma alla domanda piu' difficile dovra' rispondere il suo cuore, diviso fra l'avvenente Alice e l'altrettanto affascinante Rebecca. Tratto dal romanzo "Le domande di Brian" di David Nicholls, autore anche della sceneggiatura.

programme.title: La verità, vi spiego, sull'amore

programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Pierce Brosnan nel musical tratto dalle canzoni degli Abba. Per le sue nozze, Sophie invita tre ex amanti di sua madre, sperando finalmente di scoprire chi e' il padre.

programme.desc: Jean Pierre Jeunet dirige Audrey Tautou in un toccante dramma sentimentale. Una donna affronta gli orrori della Prima Guerra Mondiale per cercare il fidanzato, dato per disperso.

programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.desc: Phoebe Dynevor nel biopic targato Sky Original, diretto da Claire McCarthy. La storia della rivoluzionaria artista della ceramica Clarice Cliff, una delle prime esponenti dell'Art Deco.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman - Profumo di donna
programme.desc: Oscar ad Al Pacino e 3 Golden Globe per il remake americano di "Profumo di donna". Uno studente accetta di occuparsi di un ex ufficiale cieco e dal carattere impossibile.

programme.desc: Sam Claflin in una commedia romantica targata Sky Original. In Messico per promuovere il suo libro uno scrittore inglese scopre che la traduttrice lo ha trasformato in un romanzo erotico.

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sofia Coppola per una raffinata commedia romantica con Bill Murray e Scarlett Johansson. A Tokyo per uno spot, un divo americano in declino farà un incontro speciale.

programme.desc: Due nomination agli Oscar per un raffinato film sentimentale. Due amici d’infanzia si separano quando la famiglia di lei emigra dalla Corea del Sud. Dopo 2 decenni si ritrovano a New York.

programme.desc: Oscar alla colonna sonora per la commedia di Blake Edwards con Julie Andrews. Parigi, anni 30: una cantante ottiene una scrittura fingendo di essere un uomo che si traveste da donna.

programme.title: French Girl
programme.desc: Frizzante commedia romantica con Zach Braff e Vanessa Hudgens. Un insegnante di Brooklyn sta per chiedere la mano alla fidanzata quando si trova davanti una sua vecchia fiamma.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman - Profumo di donna
programme.desc: Oscar ad Al Pacino e 3 Golden Globe per il remake americano di "Profumo di donna". Uno studente accetta di occuparsi di un ex ufficiale cieco e dal carattere impossibile.

programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.desc: Commedia di Marco Martani con Andrea Arcangeli e Alessandra Mastronardi. Assalito dai dubbi prima delle nozze, un ragazzo si risveglia per magia senza la futura sposa al suo fianco.

programme.desc: Commedia di e con Sergio Castellitto, Berenice Bejo e Matilda De Angelis. Parigi: la vita monotona del proprietario di una libreria riceve una scossa grazie a un'esuberante attrice.

programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jessica Koch, un teen-movie ispirato a una storia vera con Luna Wedler e Jannik Schumann. Un oscuro segreto rende impossibile il legame fra Jessica e l'affascinante Danny.

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Dall'omonima serie tv di grande successo, i sofisticati intrighi della famiglia Crawley. Gli aristocratici padroni di casa si mobilitano per l'imminente visita dei reali d’Inghilterra.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Vicino all’orizzonte
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jessica Koch, un teen-movie ispirato a una storia vera con Luna Wedler e Jannik Schumann. Un oscuro segreto rende impossibile il legame fra Jessica e l'affascinante Danny.

programme.desc: Commedia di e con Sergio Castellitto, Berenice Bejo e Matilda De Angelis. Parigi: la vita monotona del proprietario di una libreria riceve una scossa grazie a un'esuberante attrice.

programme.title: Lei mi parla ancora
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: Quello che non so di te
programme.desc: Love story tratta dal romanzo di Jenny B. Jones. Una brillante violinista, pressata dalle sue stesse ambizioni, decide di trascorrere un semestre di studio in Irlanda. L’incontro con un giovane affascinante divo del cinema la porterà a comprendere la vera natura dei suoi sogni.

programme.title: Amore a seconda vista
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: C'è post@ per te
programme.desc: Meg Ryan e Tom Hanks in un classico della commedia romantica. La proprietaria di una libreria flirta in rete con uno sconosciuto. Scoprira' che si tratta del suo rivale in affari.

programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.desc: Florence Pugh e Andrew Garfield sono i protagonisti di una toccante storia d’amore. Dopo un incidente, Tobias e Almut vivranno un'intensa relazione tra momenti di felicità e dolore.

programme.title: Nove lune e mezza
programme.desc: Michela Andreozzi dirige e interpreta una commedia con Claudia Gerini e Giorgio Pasotti. Livia accetta di fungere da madre surrogata per co della sorella, all'insaputa dei rispettivi fidanzati.

programme.title: Vacanze romane
programme.desc: Tre Oscar e un Golden Globe per un intramontabile classico della commedia con Gregory Peck e Audrey Hepburn, premiata con l'Oscar al suo primo ruolo da protagonista. La principessa Anna giunge a Roma per una visita ufficiale. Nella Capitale incontra un reporter americano, sull'orlo del licenziamento, che le propone una 'vacanza alternativa', lontano dai rigidi e noiosi cerimoniali del protocollo. Fuggita da palazzo, vivra' una romantica avventura, scoprendo grazie al suo accompagnatore il vero volto della citta'. Ma i giornali sono sulle tracce della principessa e lo scoop e' in agguato...

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano quattro pellicole premiate a Venezia 2024, in prima visione nella collezione 'Film da Leoni', dal 27 agosto al 6 settembre.

programme.title: Vice - L'uomo nell'ombra
programme.desc: Oscar al trucco per il biopic di Adam McKay con Christian Bale, Amy Adams e Sam Rockwell. La storia di Dick Cheney, controverso vicepresidente americano durante i mandati di George W. Bush.

programme.title: Una storia nera
programme.desc: Leonardo D'Agostini firma un legal drama con Laetitia Casta e Andrea Carpenzano. Dopo anni di violenze, Carla riesce a lasciare il marito. L'uomo pero' non si rassegna a considerarla libera.

programme.title: Zero Dark Thirty
programme.desc: 1 Oscar per il thriller di Kathryn Bigelow con Joel Edgerton e Jessica Chastain, premiata ai Golden Globe. Un team della Cia collabora con i Navy Seals per catturare Osama Bin Laden.

programme.title: A.C.A.B.
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Marco Giallini e Filippo Nigro nella pellicola di Stefano Sollima. Reduci dal G8 di Genova, 3 celerini affrontano l'odio dei cittadini e una vita privata allo sbando.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Confirmation
programme.desc: Dalla sceneggiatrice di "Erin Brockovich", un political-drama con Kerry Washington. L'avvocato Anita Hill accusa di molestie il suo ex capo, nominato Giudice della Corte Suprema.

programme.title: May December
programme.desc: Julianne Moore e Natalie Portman nella pellicola di Todd Haynes. Per realizzare un film su una coppia la cui relazione aveva infiammato la stampa, un'attrice entra nella loro vita.

programme.title: The Penitent
programme.desc: Luca Barbareschi dirige e interpreta un appassionato dramma, sceneggiato da David Mamet. New York: uno psichiatra ebreo viene travolto da un processo mediatico quando si rifiuta di testimoniare a favore di un suo ex paziente omosessuale che ha compiuto una strage.

programme.title: Bernard & Doris - Complici amici
programme.desc: Susan Sarandon e Ralph Fiennes in un'eccentrica pellicola ispirata a una storia vera. Un'ereditiera instaura un insolito rapporto di amicizia e complicita' con il suo nuovo maggiordomo.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: Keira Knightley nel biopic sulla scrittrice Gabrielle Sidonie Colette. Protagonista della scena artistica nella Parigi della Belle Epoque, divenne un modello di emancipazione femminile.

programme.title: After Yang
programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.title: I dannati
programme.desc: 1862: in piena Guerra di Secessione, alcuni soldati poco esperti dell'esercito nordista devono perlustrare delle terre inesplorate e preparare il campo di battaglia. Sara' un'occasione per riflettere su un conflitto che sta sconvolgendo l'America.

programme.title: Anime nere
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Gioacchino Criaco, un viaggio infernale nel cuore della 'Ndrangheta. In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Bernard & Doris - Complici amici
programme.desc: Susan Sarandon e Ralph Fiennes in un'eccentrica pellicola ispirata a una storia vera. Un'ereditiera instaura un insolito rapporto di amicizia e complicita' con il suo nuovo maggiordomo.

programme.title: Il professore e il pazzo
programme.desc: Mel Gibson e Sean Penn nel resoconto di una storica impresa. 1879: per redigere il primo dizionario di inglese, un accademico di Oxford riceve l'aiuto di un reduce rinchiuso in manicomio.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.desc: A gawky teenager from an odd family helps his new friend run for class president against a popular student.

programme.title: Couples Retreat
programme.desc: Four couples find that paradise comes at a price when they must participate in therapy sessions at a tropical resort.

programme.title: Climax
programme.desc: When members of a dance troupe are lured to an empty school, drug-laced sangria causes their jubilant rehearsal to descend into a dark and explosive nightmare as they try to survive the night -- and find out who's responsible -- before it's too late.

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

programme.title: Mountainhead
programme.desc: Four friends reunite during worldwide economic turmoil.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: Spies (Julia Roberts, Clive Owen) for rival corporations carry on a clandestine love affair while trying to find the formula for a product that will earn a fortune for the company that patents it first.

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

programme.title: A Different Man
programme.desc: Aspiring actor Edward undergoes a radical medical procedure to drastically transform his appearance. But his new dream face turns into a nightmare as he becomes obsessed with reclaiming what he lost.

programme.title: Morbius
programme.desc: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder and determined to save others from the same fate, Dr. Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. While at first it seems to be a radical success, a darkness inside of him is soon unleashed.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: After foreign troops seize control of an American town, a group of young people takes refuge in the surrounding woods and launches guerrilla attacks against the enemy.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: A demon raised from infancy after being conjured by and rescued from the Nazis, grows up to become a defender against the forces of darkness.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: A dramatization of the disaster in April 2010, when the offshore drilling rig called the Deepwater Horizon exploded, resulting in the worst oil spill in American history.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers encounter the mighty Kong and other monstrous creatures after traveling to an uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
programme.desc: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: A sudden attack by Wulf, a ruthless Dunlending lord, forces Helm Hammerhand and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg. Finding herself in a desperate situation, Helm's daughter must lead the resistance.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Two criminals (Billy Bob Thornton, Tony Cox) disguise themselves as St. Nick and an elf to rob stores at Christmastime.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey and greed, a foulmouthed criminal (Billy Bob Thornton), his mean mother (Kathy Bates) and their angry sidekick (Tony Cox) conspire to bilk a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Aftersun
programme.desc: Years after their last vacation, Sophie reflects on the rare time spent with her loving, idealistic father, attempting to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: In the 1950s, New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever.

programme.title: Casino
programme.desc: A New York bookie (Robert De Niro) and his pal (Joe Pesci) turn a Las Vegas casino into an empire, then one's money-hungry wife (Sharon Stone) helps bring it down.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Hoping to stop a diabolical plot, the CIA implants the memories and skills of a dead agent (Ryan Reynolds) into the mind of a dangerous convict (Kevin Costner).

programme.title: Cleaner
programme.desc: Radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

programme.title: The Meg
programme.desc: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat -- a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

programme.title: The Legend of Ochi
programme.desc: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear elusive animals known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.

programme.title: Land of the Lost
programme.desc: A time-space vortex sucks a scientific has-been (Will Ferrell) and his companions (Anna Friel, Danny R. McBride) into an alternate dimension populated by dinosaurs and painfully slow creatures called Sleestaks.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: A thief (Leonardo DiCaprio) who enters people's dreams and steals their secrets gets a shot at redemption when he is given the dangerous task of planting an idea in someone's subconscious.

programme.title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
programme.desc: The magical hot tub sends Lou (Rob Corddry), Nick (Craig Robinson) and Jacob (Clark Duke) to the year 2025 to prevent an unknown assailant from shooting Lou.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots
programme.desc: When the feared Scarlet Panther comes to town, Puss is forced to give up his boots and must wear laid-back slippers which change his personality.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: In honor of Dump Day in Piqua- celebrating the creation of the dump - George and Harold try to earn extra credit by creating a trash-alanche. programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: In part one of a two-part season finale, the Melvins create a final exam that George and Harold will be sure to fail: the Doom Dome. To ensure success, Melvinborg injects Melvin's cells with nanobots, giving him heightened powers. But when George and Harold find out, they crank the nanobots to the max, causing Melvin to grow into a giant! The boys enlist Captain Underpants to fight the jealous nerd, but their victory only loses the nanobots onto Piqua...

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict “no-babies” policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: An overworked and under loved Precious has to choose between the Templeton Family startup business or Crispin Biscuits’ fun playtime. Meanwhile, the company makes its first purchase: upgraded communicators! R \u0026 D Baby Simmons is reluctant to fix the model they have, which picks up signals from her favorite lvorian soap opera, “Bridges Aflame.” Over a live broadcast, Simmons must convince the cast to tie up every loose plot thread before she has to lose the signal forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Uncle Benji makes a surprise visit to the Templeton Family with a cute baby of his own: Lil Bit Guerrero! Tina gets jealous of Carol doting on Lil Bit, while Benji reveals that in order to make his daughter proud of him, he’s applied to become a Federal Agent. With Boss Baby’s cover at stake, it’s up to the Templeton Family to get Benji out of their hair as he sniffs around for a case that could garner the attention from federal law enforcement.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: Captain Underpants becomes a wanted man in underwear when footage surfaces of a robber who looks exactly like him. George and Harold, positive it's an impostor, try to track down the perp and bring him to justice. But can the boys do this before Captain Underpants is found guilty?

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: Guy is always surprising Eep with romantic gestures and Eep wants to return the favor. But when Guy proves impossible to surprise, Eep has to step up her game.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: The Crood and Betterman parents have been struggling to get along – they’re so different! The two couple realize they need some time apart and decide to get away from the farm and each other. Too bad both couples choose to take a break on the same, small beach.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi’s building. In trying to protect Qilin from the mob of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the crew is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their distress grows upon discovering that this “Qilin” isn’t an auspicious mythical creature at all but a nefarious robot sent by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City

Saddled with these mind-blowing revelations, the crew must find a way to escape and stop Mr. Lung from using creature magic for evil.\".

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: After their intense battle against Mr. Lung, the Creature Brigade disbands, leaving Yi and Everest as the remaining creature helpers. Meanwhile, Jin and Peng end up on their own creature mission of sorts. Eventually the crew reunites, and together they are able to return Taisui and end the loop.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: The fairies are giving a big fairy flying display in Toyland. Fairy Coco is devastated when her wings disappear just before the Flying Display. Queen Sparklewings tells Noddy that the wings will only work for Fairy Coco and if anybody else tries to use them it would be dangerous as they may fall and hurt themselves. Noddy immediately stars to investigate. Following all the clues, he works out that Smartysaurus found the wings after Fairy Coco took them off in the Fairy Garden. And now she's planning on flying with them! Noddy, Bumpy and Revs rush to the DinoHills to save Smartysaurus before she has a nasty accident. The big dinosaur is very excited about flying. Clever Noddy has an idea though and later that evening, at the flying display, Smartysaurus, Toyland's first flying dinosaur makes her debut – with a little help from the building crane and a big dino-harness! Noddy's saved the day again. Case closed!

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service
programme.desc: Hopes are high for this evening's hoe-down on Greendale's village green - especially among PC Selby and Ted, who each harbour hopes of dancing with Dr Gilbertson. But when the bronco is accidentally switched on in the back of Pat's van, it rolls away and Pat can't find a way to recapture it. He enlists Amy's help, but jealous Pumpkin pushes the bronco away, making matters worse. Meanwhile PC Selby and Ted are each determined to be the best banjo-playing dancers Greendale (or more specifically, Dr Gilbertson) has ever seen… Pat has a great idea to catch the escaped bronco, using Dr Gilbertson's lasso-throwing skills. As Pat drives her sports car, Dr G throws the lasso - and captures the mechanical horse just in time. As she does a celebratory dance with both PC Selby and Ted, Pat is the toast of the hoe-down. Mission Accomplished!

programme.desc: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation….

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists

programme.desc: Saat suami Celeste Beard tewas dibunuh oleh Tracey, temannya yang mengalami delusi dan gangguan kejiwaan, Celeste yakin ia tidak akan pernah disalahkan. Namun, putri kembarnya menemukan kebenaran.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Jared menduga bahwa ia dan keluarganya tidak sendirian saat pindah ke Spiderwick Estate nan misterius. Sementara itu, raksasa Mulgarath menjalankan rencana jahatnya usai berubah bentuk.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Jared mengajak Simon, Mallory, dan sekutu baru yang mencurigakan guna memasang sejumlah perangkap untuk makhluk di Spiderwick Estate. Helen semakin akrab dengan musuh kala memimpin pencarian Bibi Lucinda.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Jared dan Simon menjalin persahabatan yang tak terduga usai menemukan buku panduan pertama mereka. Mallory kesulitan untuk beradaptasi di Henson, sementara Helen berurusan dengan ibunya yang sedang berkunjung.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Jared dan Simon berhasil menangkap Thimbletack, tetapi mereka merasa ragu untuk memercayai si boggart. Bree mendesak Mallory untuk mengadakan pesta di Spiderwick Estate demi bertemu dengan anak-anak lain di kota.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Simon pergi ke New York untuk meminta bantuan ayahnya dan mengajak Calliope untuk mendapatkan dukungan moral. Jared dan Thimbletack bekerja sama untuk menemukan naga dalam persaingan melawan Mulgarath.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Mallory dan Jared bekerja sama untuk menemukan satu-satunya senjata yang dapat menghentikan Mulgarath, yaitu Pedang Vorpal. Simon dan Calliope merasa putus asa kala mencoba menyelamatkan naga-naga Mulgarath.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Mulgarath menahan Jared di Meskwaki karena bertekad untuk menemukan lokasi naga. Jared telah bertemu dengan tandingannya dalam diri sang raksasa dan menjadi korban manipulasinya.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Jared, Simon, dan Mallory harus berdamai untuk menyelamatkan Helen dan seluruh Henson dari nafsu makan Mulgarath yang tak terkendali. Jared belajar untuk menerima kekurangannya dan melihatnya sebagai kekuatan.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: A gangster, who seeks to retire from the life of crime, faces a threat when an upcoming rival challenges his authority. He then decides to take help from a trustworthy former apprentice.

programme.title: Superfast!
programme.desc: Undercover agent Lucas White endeavours to join Vin Serento's gang of street racers. Together, they plan to steal a large amount of money from crime kingpin Juan Carlos.

programme.title: Transporter 2
programme.desc: Transporter Frank Martin temporarily works as a driver for a politician's child. However, when a drug cartel kidnaps the boy, Frank must rescue him while being accused of committing the crime himself.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alice wakes up to find that Raccoon city is infested with zombies and monsters. Later, she tries her best to find a way out of the city before it is too late.

programme.title: Now You See Me 2
programme.desc: Dylan secretly guides the Horsemen as they reappear with a bold plan, only to be drawn into a tech billionaire's twisted scheme involving a powerful data chip.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, seeking revenge for his father's death, declares war on Greece. As a result, Themistocles, the Athenian admiral, is compelled to form an alliance with Sparta to protect Athens.

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: Agent 007, along with Natalia Simonav, travels to Russia to locate the satellite nuclear weapon stolen by Alec, a former agent, who Bond believed was dead.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: After Paris, a Trojan prince, has an affair with Menelaus's wife, Helen, he decides to take her with him. Later, Menelaus's brother uses that as an excuse to wage a war against the city of Troy.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: John Wharton, the captain of an elite task force, raids a safe house owned by one of the most lethal drug cartels with his team. Though the mission is successful, death awaits them.
